title: Invoice Organizer
description: Identifies incoming invoices and keeps them together for structured processing and bookkeeping.

filter.name: Invoice Detector
filter.description: Detects emails containing invoices, billing notices, or payment receipts.
filter.prompt: Determine whether this email contains or references an incoming invoice, billing statement, or receipt for purchased goods or services. Answer with high certainty.

generator.name: Invoice Metadata Extractor
generator.description: Extracts key invoice data into a clean structured summary.
generator.prompt:
Extract all key invoice information from the source email:
- Vendor / Company Name
- Invoice Number
- Invoice Date
- Payment Due Date
- Currency and Total Amount (Gross and Net if present)
- Tax / VAT Amount
- Line Items Summary (Item, Qty, Price)
- Payment Instructions (IBAN/Wire/Link)

Format your output as clean, professional Markdown with a summary table.

title: Supplier Quote Organizer
description: Collects incoming supplier quotations and keeps them organized for easy review and comparison.

filter.name: Supplier Quote Detector
filter.description: Identifies emails containing price quotes or estimates from vendors.
filter.prompt: Determine whether this email is an incoming price quote, cost estimate, or proposal from a vendor, contractor, or supplier.

generator.name: Supplier Quote Extractor
generator.description: Extracts quote specifications, pricing, and terms into Markdown.
generator.prompt:
Extract the supplier quote details from the email:
- Supplier / Vendor Name
- Quote / Reference Number
- Quote Date and Validity Expiration Date
- Itemized Products / Services and Unit Costs
- Total Estimated Cost
- Delivery Timeframe / Lead Times
- Payment and Delivery Terms

Format the output in a structured Markdown table.

title: Application Organizer
description: Identifies incoming job applications and keeps them organized by candidate and position.

filter.name: Job Application Detector
filter.description: Detects job applications, candidate resumes, and cover letters.
filter.prompt: Determine whether this email is an incoming job application, resume/CV submission, or recruitment candidacy inquiry.

generator.name: Candidate Profile Extractor
generator.description: Extracts applicant background and contact details into a standardized brief.
generator.prompt:
Analyze the candidate application in the email and extract:
- Candidate Name
- Position / Role Applied For
- Contact Details (Email, Phone, Location, LinkedIn/Portfolio)
- Years of Experience & Education Highlights
- Core Skills & Technologies
- Salary Expectations & Availability (if stated)
- Executive Summary (3-4 sentences)

Present the profile in a clear Markdown format.

title: Bills & Payments
description: Identifies bills, payment notices and related emails and keeps them organized in one place.

filter.name: Bill & Payment Detector
filter.description: Identifies recurring utility bills, service charges, and payment reminders.
filter.prompt: Determine whether this email is a bill, utility charge, payment notice, or account billing reminder.

generator.name: Bill Summary Extractor
generator.description: Extracts bill amount, due date, and account details.
generator.prompt:
Extract bill particulars from the email:
- Service / Utility Provider
- Account / Customer ID
- Billing Period
- Amount Due and Currency
- Due Date
- Payment Method (Autopay, Bank Transfer, Online Link)

Format as a concise Markdown summary.

title: Subscription Noise
description: Identifies recurring subscription and service emails and separates them from important inbox traffic.

filter.name: Subscription Email Detector
filter.description: Identifies recurring SaaS subscriptions, newsletter renewals, and automated service notices.
filter.prompt: Determine whether this email is an automated recurring subscription notice, receipt, plan renewal, or service upgrade notification.

generator.name: Subscription Brief
generator.description: Summarizes the subscription renewal and cost.
generator.prompt:
Summarize the subscription update:
- Service / App Name
- Plan or Tier
- Amount Charged / Upcoming Charge
- Renewal Frequency & Next Renewal Date
- Action Needed (None / Account Update Needed)

Output as a brief bulleted list.

title: FYI / No Action Needed
description: Identifies informational emails that do not require a response or action and keeps them out of the way.

filter.name: Informational Email Detector
filter.description: Detects purely informational broadcasts and system notifications requiring zero action.
filter.prompt: Determine whether this email is purely informational (broadcast announcement, system update notice, read receipt, automated log, or general FYI) that requires NO response or action from the recipient.

generator.name: Informational Summary
generator.description: Provides a 1-sentence TL;DR of the informational email.
generator.prompt: Provide a 1-2 sentence executive summary of what this informational email covers. Confirm clearly that no action is required.

title: Research & Newsletter Filter
description: Identifies relevant research, newsletters and publications and separates them from general inbox noise.

filter.name: Research & Publication Detector
filter.description: Detects academic newsletters, market reports, and scientific updates.
filter.prompt: Determine whether this email is an industry newsletter, technical report, scientific publication, or academic digest.

generator.name: Publication Digest
generator.description: Extracts key insights and executive summaries from research newsletters.
generator.prompt:
Analyze the research or newsletter content and generate a digest:
- Source / Publication Name
- Primary Topics Covered
- Top 3-5 Key Insights & Data Points
- Relevant Links & Resources

Format clearly in Markdown with bold key takeaways.

title: Smart Project Filing
description: Identifies which project an email belongs to and automatically organizes it with the relevant project communication.

filter.name: Project Communication Detector
filter.description: Identifies emails containing project updates, task deliverables, or client milestones.
filter.prompt: Determine whether this email is related to an ongoing business project, client deliverable, milestone update, or technical work stream.

generator.name: Project Log Entry
generator.description: Structures project updates with action items and owners.
generator.prompt:
Extract and structure project communications:
- Identified Project / Topic Name
- Summary of Updates or Discussions
- Decisions Made
- Action Items Assigned (Task, Assignee, Due Date)
- Open Questions Requiring Resolution

Format as structured Markdown.

title: New Sales Inquiry

filter.name: Sales Inquiry Detector

filter.prompt: Determine whether this email is a new incoming sales lead, prospect inquiry, request for pricing, or business proposal from a potential customer.

generator.name: Sales Lead Alert Card

- Contact Information

- Budget / Scope / Quantities Indicated
- Key Questions or Requirements

title: High Value Lead Alert

filter.name: High Value Lead Classifier
filter.description: Filters for enterprise-level or large budget leads.
filter.prompt: Determine whether this email represents an exceptionally high-value sales opportunity, enterprise account, large volume inquiry, or high-urgency contract.

generator.name: VIP Lead Dossier
generator.description: Generates high-priority lead briefing with recommended action.

Create an Executive High-Value Opportunity Alert:
- Account / Prospect Name & Size
- Estimated Deal Value / Scope
- Executive Decision Makers Involved
- Business Pain Points Stated
- Immediate Recommended Next Step

Format with prominent Markdown callouts.

title: Needs My Reply
description: Finds emails where someone is waiting for your response or action.

filter.name: Direct Reply Detector
filter.description: Identifies emails containing unanswered direct questions or calls to action.
filter.prompt: Determine whether this email contains direct questions, requests for approval, or feedback waiting specifically for the recipient's personal reply.

generator.name: Action Required Summary
generator.description: Highlights questions and decisions awaiting your response.
generator.prompt:
Extract the action requirements from this email:
- Sender Name & Urgency
- Exact Questions / Decisions Awaiting Your Reply
- Relevant Deadlines or Time Constraints
- Suggested Brief Response Outline

Format as bulleted Markdown.

title: Customer Complaint Alert
description: Detects customer complaints and highlights issues that may require immediate attention.

filter.name: Customer Frustration & Complaint Detector
filter.description: Flags customer dissatisfaction, service problems, and negative sentiment.
filter.prompt: Determine whether this email expresses customer dissatisfaction, frustration, an unresolved problem, a refund request, or a formal complaint.

generator.name: Complaint Incident Brief
generator.description: Summarizes the root problem and customer sentiment.

Generate an Incident Support Brief:

- Severity Level (Critical / High / Medium)

- Customer Sentiment & Escalation Risk
- Recommended Immediate Mitigation & Response Strategy

Format clearly in Markdown.

title: VIP Customer Alert
description: Alerts you when an email comes from an important or high-value customer.

filter.name: VIP Account Detector
filter.description: Identifies emails from key accounts, partners, or executive clients.
filter.prompt: Determine whether this email is sent by an executive, strategic client, key partner, or VIP customer requiring prompt attention.

generator.name: VIP Message Summary
generator.description: Summarizes VIP customer correspondence for quick review.

Output in clean Markdown format.

title: Payment Request Detector
description: Identifies emails containing payment requests and brings them to your attention.

filter.name: Payment Request Classifier
filter.description: Detects explicit payment requests and wire instructions.
filter.prompt: Determine whether this email contains an explicit request for payment, wire transfer, overdue remittance, or direct transaction settlement.

generator.name: Payment Request Summary
generator.description: Extracts amounts, bank details, and payment due dates.
generator.prompt:
Extract payment request information:
- Payee / Requester Name
- Amount Requested and Currency
- Due Date
- Payment Method / Wire Details
- Invoice / Reference Number
- Is Overdue: (Yes/No)

Format as a concise Markdown summary.

title: Approval Required
description: Finds emails containing decisions, approvals or confirmations waiting for you.

filter.name: Manager Approval Detector
filter.description: Flags emails asking for formal authorization or management approval.
filter.prompt: Determine whether this email requires management approval, formal sign-off, purchase authorization, or executive confirmation.

generator.name: Approval Request Brief
generator.description: Summarizes the request, cost impact, and decision options.
generator.prompt:
Summarize the approval request:
- Requester Name & Department
- Item / Initiative Requiring Approval
- Cost / Budget / Resource Impact
- Business Justification
- Deadline for Decision
- Options: [Approve / Reject / Request More Info]

Format as structured Markdown.

title: Deadline Alert
description: Detects important deadlines hidden inside email conversations.

filter.name: Deadline & Milestone Detector
filter.description: Identifies dates, milestone deadlines, and submission cut-offs.
filter.prompt: Determine whether this email contains an important target deadline, submission cut-off date, expiring offer, or time-sensitive task.

generator.name: Deadline Extraction Card
generator.description: Extracts exact dates, tasks, and consequences of the deadline.
generator.prompt:
Extract all deadlines mentioned in the email:
- Specific Task or Milestone
- Exact Due Date & Time (with timezone)
- Responsible Party
- Stated Consequences / Next Steps

Format as a prominent Markdown table or list.

title: Supplier Problem Alert
description: Identifies supplier emails indicating delays, shortages, quality issues or other problems.

filter.name: Supply Chain Issue Detector

filter.prompt: Determine whether this email from a vendor or supplier reports a shipping delay, backorder, defective product, price dispute, or fulfillment failure.

generator.name: Supplier Issue Summary

Generate a Supplier Problem Report:

- Impact on Operations

filter.name: Price Change Detector

filter.prompt: Determine whether this email communicates a price increase, rate adjustment, updated tariff, or new fee schedule.

generator.name: Price Change Assessment
generator.description: Summarizes the old vs new pricing and financial impact.
generator.prompt:
Summarize the price modification notice:
- Vendor / Service Provider
- Affected Products / Services

Format as Markdown.

title: Suspicious Email Detector
description: Flags emails that appear suspicious, unusual or potentially fraudulent.

filter.name: Phishing & Fraud Classifier
filter.description: Flags fraudulent emails, spoofing attempts, and phishing lures.
filter.prompt: Determine whether this email appears suspicious, contains signs of phishing, CEO fraud/impersonation, deceptive bank account changes, or suspicious urgency.

generator.name: Security Threat Advisory
generator.description: Analyzes suspicious indicators and warns user.
generator.prompt:
Analyze the security risk of this email:
- Risk Assessment (High / Medium / Low)
- Identified Red Flags (e.g. Sender Spoofing, Urgency, Unverified Bank Details, Malicious Links)
- Safe Verification Instructions (e.g. Call sender via known phone number)

Format with bold security warning formatting.

title: Meeting / Appointment Detector

filter.name: Scheduling & Meeting Classifier

filter.prompt: Determine whether this email is an invitation, scheduling request, proposed meeting timeslot, or appointment confirmation.

generator.name: Meeting Invitation Summary

- Organizer and Key Attendees
- Proposed Date(s) & Time(s) (with Timezone)
- Meeting Link / Location (Zoom/Teams/Physical)
- Agenda / Topics to Prepare

Output as structured Markdown.

title: Long Email → Short Version
description: Turns long emails into concise summaries containing the information that matters.

filter.name: Long Email Filter
filter.description: Identifies detailed or lengthy email threads.
filter.prompt: Determine whether this email or email thread contains detailed discussion, lengthy text, or multiple discussion points.

generator.name: Executive TL;DR Generator
generator.description: Generates a 3-bullet summary with action items.
generator.prompt:
Summarize this long email concisely:
- **TL;DR** (1-2 sentences capturing core message)
- **Key Points** (3-5 bullet points)
- **Decisions Made** (if any)
- **Action Items & Owners** (Who needs to do what by when)

Keep it brief and high impact.
